Answer “is this repository ready to commit?” with one aggregate check:
  blocking: ActionableMissing / PendingCurationMissing / Stale / Unbaselined / dictionary violations / format errors / pending Entries or Curation drafts;
  reported but non-blocking: RawMissing / CurationExcludedMissing / non-Pending SkippedMissing / Orphan / LineEndingOnly / S quota / E scale / tagparse Warning.
Use aoci verify for the four raw states, the Missing partition, and complete Curation paths.
For verify, check, index score, and index inventory, “read-only” means that the formal index and Baseline are not modified; it does not mean strictly zero filesystem writes. When Ledger is enabled, all four commands may append to the local Ledger, and verify also attempts to write Verify History. An audit-write failure does not change existing exit codes or governance criteria.
